articles.title: Wisdom doesn’t come automatically with age, according to two studies: research on 693 people found both younger and older adults reasoned more wisely about a friend’s problems than their own identical ones, a gap that closed only when people were taught to mentally step outside themselves, and a separate study found wisdom was tied not to how often people reflected on hard experiences but to how deeply they worked to find meaning in them
